# update-documentation

## Use when
Code, workflows, or setup changed and docs need to match reality.

## Inputs
- changed behavior or files
- target docs to update

## Steps
1. Confirm the current behavior from source files.
2. Update the smallest relevant docs set.
3. Use actual commands, paths, and examples.
4. Mark placeholders or manual follow-up explicitly.
5. Verify links and references still work.

## Safety limits
- Do not invent commands or unsupported workflows.
- Distinguish reusable guidance from repo-specific content.

## Output
Provide updated documentation plus any remaining manual follow-up.
